body:
## 操作任务
实现migrate(request,case,pending)，case为批准old/new/alias且仅小写字母开头、后续小写字母数字_-、最长61；非法ValueError。新索引1 shard/0 replicas并显式status=keyword；真实_reindex将旧status转字符串、检查failures，再按稳定ID回放保存的拒绝事件，最后原子将写别名从old移至new且is_write_index=true。不得改旧字段类型、删旧索引、丢原Bulk已成功项或丢拒绝事件。request返回(status,JSON)，非成功必须抛RuntimeError。不改case/pending。平台真实动态long冲突、Bulk HTTP200内400/201并存，恢复后历史/拒绝/未来字符串均可查询且旧索引数据不变。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实固定Elasticsearch8.19.7隔离单节点与Painless/reindex/Bulk/alias，原始拒绝事件由实际返回对应输入留存。只验证受控静止写窗口迁移，不宣称生产并发双写、跨集群或原索引删除审批已完成。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,time,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def create(server,index,extra=None):
 settings=dict(number_of_shards=1,number_of_replicas=0);settings.update(extra or {})
 status,value=server.request('PUT','/'+index,dict(settings=settings));assert status==200,(status,value)
def docs(server,index):
 status,value=server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000&track_total_hits=true');assert status==200,(status,value)
 return {row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in value['hits']['hits']}
def bulk(server,index,records):
 lines=[]
 for event in records:lines.extend([json.dumps({'index':{'_index':index,'_id':event['_id']}}),json.dumps(event['_source'])])
 return server.request('POST','/_bulk?refresh=true','\n'.join(lines)+'\n',content_type='application/x-ndjson')
with Elasticsearch() as server:
 case=dict(old='mapping_old',new='mapping_new',alias='mapping_write');create(server,case['old'])
 assert server.request('POST','/_aliases',{'actions':[{'add':{'index':case['old'],'alias':case['alias'],'is_write_index':True}}]})[0]==200
 originals=[dict(_id='keep-a',_source=dict(status=200,message='original-a')),dict(_id='keep-b',_source=dict(status=404,message='original-b'))]
 status,value=bulk(server,case['alias'],originals);assert status==200 and not value['errors']
 submitted=[dict(_id='rejected',_source=dict(status='error',message='preserved-rejected-event')),dict(_id='accepted',_source=dict(status=503,message='already-accepted'))]
 status,value=bulk(server,case['alias'],submitted);assert status==200 and value['errors'] and [row['index']['status'] for row in value['items']]==[400,201]
 assert 'mapper_parsing_exception' in json.dumps(value) or 'document_parsing_exception' in json.dumps(value)
 pending=[submitted[0]];old_docs=docs(server,case['old']);assert set(old_docs)=={'keep-a','keep-b','accepted'}
 old_mapping=server.request('GET','/'+case['old']+'/_mapping')[1];assert old_mapping[case['old']]['mappings']['properties']['status']['type']=='long'
 before=copy.deepcopy((case,pending))
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_DYNAMIC_LONG_MAPPING_BULK_HTTP200_ONE400_ONE201_REJECTED_EVENT_RETAINED',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:new_keyword_index_reindex_replay_then_atomic_alias_cutover',flush=True)
 try:task.migrate(server.request,case,pending)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual mapping migration/replay failed') from error
 expected={key:{**body,'status':str(body['status'])} for key,body in old_docs.items()};expected['rejected']=submitted[0]['_source']
 assert docs(server,case['alias'])==docs(server,case['new'])==expected,'historical/rejected records missing or source statuses not normalized'
 assert docs(server,case['old'])==old_docs and server.request('GET','/'+case['old']+'/_mapping')[1]==old_mapping
 mapping=server.request('GET','/'+case['new']+'/_mapping')[1];assert mapping[case['new']]['mappings']['properties']['status']['type']=='keyword'
 status,aliases=server.request('GET','/_alias/'+case['alias']);assert status==200 and set(aliases)=={case['new']} and aliases[case['new']]['aliases'][case['alias']]['is_write_index'] is True
 status,value=server.request('GET','/'+case['alias']+'/_search',{'query':{'term':{'status':'error'}}});assert status==200 and value['hits']['total']=={'value':1,'relation':'eq'}
 status,value=server.request('PUT','/'+case['alias']+'/_doc/future?refresh=true',dict(status='new-format',message='write-contract-control'));assert status in (200,201)
 assert server.request('GET','/'+case['new']+'/_doc/future')[0]==200 and server.request('GET','/'+case['old']+'/_doc/future')[0]==404
 assert (case,pending)==before
 print('NATIVE_MAPPING_EXPLICIT_KEYWORD_OLD_AND_REJECTED_DATA_PRESENT_OLD_INDEX_RETAINED_NEW_FORMAT_WRITES',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

body:
## 操作任务
实现repair(request,case,records)，先按批准old/new/alias原子_aliases更新old is_write_index=false、new true，保持两者别名读取范围，再用稳定ID对原失败批发_bulk?refresh=true，NDJSON以换行结尾、逐项errors必须false且items数一致；非成功抛RuntimeError。索引/alias仅小写字母开头、后续小写数字_-、最长61，非法ValueError；不改输入。真实旧别名同时指向两索引而无唯一写索引，原批所有项400、未写入；修复后仅新代接收重试项、旧代数据和查询范围保持。不能删索引、移除旧代读范围或让两个write=true。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7 aliases原子更新及Bulk逐项写入、同一稳定文档ID受控重试。没有生产账号/外部集群修改，不证明未知结果自动ID请求的幂等性。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

body:
## 操作任务
实现restore(request,index)，只对批准字面索引PUT /index/_settings设置index.refresh_interval=1s，再POST /index/_refresh一次；非200或刷新分片failed抛RuntimeError。仅小写字母开头、后续小写数字_-、最长61，非法ValueError。真实导入索引-1下已确认ID实时GET存在而搜索为空；恢复后原ID可检索，UUID/分片/副本保持。平台随后实际128条Bulk记录吞吐和周期可见耗时，不再每条强制refresh；旁索引保持-1及不可搜索，不允许全局/_refresh越界影响它。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7实时GET、搜索reader、手动/周期refresh与128条有限吞吐观测；不宣称生产容量、持久化/宕机恢复、刷新实时SLA或逐条refresh吞吐压测完成。

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,time,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def create(server,index,extra=None):
 settings=dict(number_of_shards=1,number_of_replicas=0);settings.update(extra or {})
 status,value=server.request('PUT','/'+index,dict(settings=settings));assert status==200,(status,value)
def docs(server,index):
 status,value=server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000&track_total_hits=true');assert status==200,(status,value)
 return {row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in value['hits']['hits']}
def bulk(server,index,records):
 lines=[]
 for event in records:lines.extend([json.dumps({'index':{'_index':index,'_id':event['_id']}}),json.dumps(event['_source'])])
 return server.request('POST','/_bulk?refresh=true','\n'.join(lines)+'\n',content_type='application/x-ndjson')
with Elasticsearch() as server:
 index='import_target';other='untouched_pending';create(server,index,dict(refresh_interval='-1'));create(server,other,dict(refresh_interval='-1'))
 for name in (index,other):assert server.request('PUT','/'+name+'/_doc/confirmed',dict(value=name))[0] in (200,201)
 assert server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_doc/confirmed')[1]['found'] is True and docs(server,index)=={} and docs(server,other)=={}
 settings=server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_settings')[1][index]['settings']['index'];uuid=settings['uuid']
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_ACK_REALTIME_GET_FOUND_BUT_SEARCH_EMPTY_REFRESH_DISABLED',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:restore_target_refresh_policy_once_at_bulk_boundary',flush=True)
 calls=[]
 def request(method,path,body=None,**kwargs):calls.append((method,path));return server.request(method,path,body,**kwargs)
 try:task.restore(request,index)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual search visibility recovery failed') from error
 assert docs(server,index)=={'confirmed':dict(value=index)},'confirmed original document is still not searchable'
 assert docs(server,other)=={},'unapproved global refresh changed unrelated index visibility'
 current=server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_settings')[1][index]['settings']['index']
 assert current['uuid']==uuid and current['number_of_shards']==settings['number_of_shards'] and current['number_of_replicas']==settings['number_of_replicas'] and current['refresh_interval']=='1s'
 assert calls==[('PUT','/'+index+'/_settings'),('POST','/'+index+'/_refresh')],'refresh was not scoped and performed once at approved boundary'

 deadline=time.monotonic()+4
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  if len(docs(server,index))==129:break

 else:raise AssertionError('future confirmed batch not visible under restored periodic policy')
